preferences.observation: Leader/horse before crowd; no incremental known-defect handover.

method.observation: Keep71 whole scene. Rebuild beard path lengths by anatomical root zone: short cheek flow hugs actual rest skin, lower jaw/chin release into longer grouped forms. Add short overlapping upper-lip strands, preserving same head owner. Scale existing owned featureless pigment crop without transferring Pashtun facial features. Verify all animation key signatures unchanged.

interfaces.comparison: Same attachment does not guarantee visible integration; reverse and intended view veto.

efficient_quality.observation: Cheap actual scoped views before continuous render; no noise-only polishing.
efficient_quality.comparison: No useful outcome claimed from tests or source hashes.

authority.observation: Five additional68–72 on existing appearance task; motion16 preserved, no crowd/spend.

strongest_counterexample: A rounded silhouette can remain a synthetic beard with disconnected roots; a smooth sash can still float through its support. Actual multi-view and intended-shot evidence, not geometry metrics, decide.
